== frame after_cd cursor=5,37
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ mkdir -p repo/.git
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ printf 'ref: refs/heads/late-branch\n' > repo/.git/HEAD
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd repo
|testuser@<HOST> ~/repo late-branch $
